statusHistory.note: Operator asked in chat (2026-09-25) for a genuinely good walking-distance food option near Jabaquara metro station — explicit operator commission, trust: auto. Checked several candidates by actual walking distance first: É do Pará (Saúde) is 3.2km/8min drive, not walking distance; Jaco (Michelin-listed) is in Pinheiros, unrelated; Osnir Hamburger is near Praça da Árvore station, not Jabaquara. Jóia de Minas confirmed at 800m/11-minute walk via Google Maps directions from the actual Jabaquara-Comitê Paralímpico station point. Sourced from Google Maps (verified pin, 4.5/3,273 reviews read for both praise and a genuine complaint — a thin vaca atolada portion — surfaced honestly rather than only the positive average), cardapio.menu for pricing, and directory listings for description/signature-dish confirmation. Restaurant's own official site (restaurantejoiademinas.com.br) is currently DNS-dead — noted in-body rather than cited. Instagram handle @joiademinas belongs to an unrelated frozen-pão-de-queijo wholesaler in Arcos, MG, not this restaurant; the Instagram location-tag page for this venue exists but only surfaces customer check-in photos with identifiable faces, so it was not used for imagery. No r/SaoPaulo or other Reddit coverage found for this small neighborhood spot — genuinely thin UGC catalogue for the area, logged rather than forced. No genuine dated event; this is an evergreen neighborhood restaurant, not an events venue. Internal-link gap logged to content/requests.md — no other published Near place is close enough or thematically matched (Minas Gerais home cooking) to earn a real in-text link. Dedupe clean — no existing São Paulo pin within kilometers. All six locales, mechanical gates pass.

Image fix (operator report, 2026-11-05): the hero was a raw lh3.googleusercontent.com signed URL, not a locally-hosted file -- those URLs expire, and it had broken on the live page. Replaced with a real, venue-specific photo the operator supplied via the photo inbox (joia_044.jpg), hosted locally under public/places/joia-de-minas-jabaquara-sao-paulo/hero.jpg. Standing lesson: no hero image should ever point directly at a Google-hosted signed URL -- always download/host locally even when the source photo comes from Google Maps.
